data.paraphrase: For every function f from the natural numbers to the natural numbers, if f(n) is equal to the cardinality of the set of all multisets M where each element m in M is a factorial of some integer between 1 and n, and the sum of all elements in M equals n factorial, then there exists a constant C such that for all natural numbers n greater than or equal to 2, f(n) is bounded above and below by expressions involving n raised to the power of n squared over 2 plus or minus C times n, multiplied by an exponential term involving n squared over 4.
